arguments.rule_content:
title: HTML Smuggling Detected - ISO Dropped from JavaScript
logsource:
  category: web_proxy
  product: any
  service: any
  description: Detects JavaScript that assembles and downloads ISO files

detection:
  selection:
    - content_type: 'application/x-iso9660-image'
    - filename|endswith: '.iso'
    - user_agent: 'Mozilla/5.0 (*Windows NT*; *Win64; x64*) AppleWebKit/* (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/* Safari/*'
    - http_method: 'GET'
    - js_b64decode|re: '.*atob\(.*'
    - js_blob_create|re: '.*new Blob\(.*type.*iso.*'
  condition: selection
level: high
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1071/001/
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate ISO downloads via web (rare)
author: SOC Team

title: HTML Smuggling Detected - ISO Dropped from JavaScript
logsource:
  category: web_proxy
  product: any
  service: ...

rule Suspicious_LNK_Dropping_ISO {
    meta:
        description = "Detects LNK files that execute commands to drop or invoke ISO images"
        author = "SOC Team"
        date = "2026-04-09"
        malpedia_reference = "https://malpedia.caad.fkie.fraunhofer.de/details/win.lnk"
        malpedia_version = "20260409"
        malpedia_license = "CC BY-NC-SA 4.0"
        malpedia_sharing = "TLP:AMBER"
    strings:
        $cmd_drop_iso = /cmd\.exe.*\/c.*powershell.*-ep bypass.*-f.*\.ps1/i
        $iso_ext = ".iso" wide ascii
        $mount_exec = "Mount-DiskImage" wide ascii
        $extract_cmd = "expand-archive" wide ascii
    condition:
        $cmd_drop_iso and ($iso_ext or $mount_exec or $extract_cmd)
}

import base64
from PIL import Image

def embed_data(image_path, data, output_path):
    img = Image.open(image_path)
    binary_data = ''.join(format(b, '08b') for b in data)
    data_len = len(binary_data)
    
    pixels = iter(img.getdata())
    new_pixels = []
    
    for i in range(0, data_len, 3):
        rgb = [value for value in pixels.__next__()[:3]]
        for j in range(3):
            if i + j < data_len:
                rgb[j] = (rgb[j] & ~1) | int(binary_data[i + j])
        new_pixels.append(tuple(rgb))
    
    # Write remaining pixels
    new_pixels += [px[:3] for px in pixels]
    
    result_img = Image.new(img.mode, img.size)
    result_img.putdata(new_pixels)
    result_img.save(output_path)
